writeup: AGM's flagship Secutor LRF 75-640 thermal rifle scope, with a 640x512 sub-20mK sensor, 75mm lens, 4-32x zoom and a built-in 1000m laser rangefinder, is $1,825.34 on Woot in open-box condition. EuroOptic sells it new for $5,995 and AGM lists it at $6,495, so this is roughly $4,170 less. Woot shows only one left, limit 2, with a 90-day Woot warranty.
